note: What a server sends to play a voice event. The header carries zero.

fields.name: folder
fields.note: The event's folder.

fields.name: event
fields.note: The event's name.

fields.name: callback
fields.note: Nonzero has a client follow the event to its end under handle; that it then sends VoiceEventDone is not recorded. A client sends VoiceEventDone at once where it cannot play the event, whatever this holds.

fields.name: handle
fields.note: A number a client returns in VoiceEventDone.

fields.name: folder
fields.note: The event's folder. It has no effect where kind is 1.

fields.name: event
fields.note: The event's name; for kind 1, the conversation's.

fields.name: callback
fields.note: For kind 0, nonzero asks the client to send VoiceEventDone once the event has played. A client sends it at once where it cannot play the event, whatever this holds.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of event. A client does nothing for any other value.

1.name: champion
1.note: A conversation played in the voice of the champion named by handle, where sound is on and the client knows the champion.
